# omniddi_network_spaces (Data Source)

Lists network spaces, optionally narrowed by exact `name` and by `state`. Matching none is not an error. Needs a platform role with `read_network_spaces`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_network_spaces" "active" {
  state = "ACTIVE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Return only the space with exactly this name.
- `state` (String) Return only spaces in this state: `PROVISIONING`, `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DELETING`.

### Read-Only

- `network_spaces` (Attributes List) The matching network spaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_spaces))

<a id="nestedatt--network_spaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_spaces`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the space is active and current, so it can be worked in.
- `description` (String) Description of the space.
- `id` (Number) Network space id.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default space.
- `name` (String) Network space name.
- `server_count` (Number) Number of servers in the space.
- `state` (String) `PROVISIONING`, `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DELETING`.
